items.stem: Before relying on a factual claim that Gemini produced in a work document, a user should:

options.text: Verify it against an authoritative source
options.rationale: Correct: generative output can be wrong, so factual claims must be verified.

options.text: Assume it is correct because the AI stated it confidently
options.rationale: Confidence does not guarantee accuracy; verification is needed.

options.text: Delete the document to be safe
options.rationale: Deleting is unnecessary; verifying the claim is the right step.
Spell-check is unrelated to factual accuracy.

items.explanation: Correct: Verify it against an authoritative source.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO are good prompting practices for work tasks with Gemini? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Give specific context, audience and desired format
options.rationale: Correct: specificity and context produce more useful output.

options.text: Iterate and refine the prompt based on results
options.rationale: Correct: refining the prompt improves the response.

options.text: Paste confidential customer data regardless of policy
options.rationale: Sensitive data handling must follow policy; this is a privacy risk.

options.text: Keep prompts as vague as possible
options.rationale: Vague prompts yield weaker, less relevant output.

items.explanation: Correct: Give specific context, audience and desired format, Iterate and refine the prompt based on results.

items.stem: Which task is Gemini in Workspace well suited to assist with?

options.text: Drafting a first version of a document to then edit
options.rationale: Correct: generating a starting draft to refine is a core strength.

options.text: Making final legal decisions with no human review
options.rationale: High-stakes judgment needs human review, not autonomous AI.
Output must be verified; it is not guaranteed error-free.

options.text: Replacing all human verification of facts
options.rationale: Verification by a human remains necessary.
